children: Mistras Group voluntarily supplemented its merger proxy statement with additional disclosures after stockholder lawsuits challenged the merger disclosures.
Two lawsuits allege the proxy omitted or misrepresented material information and seek, among other relief, to enjoin the merger; Mistras Group says the claims lack merit.
The supplement adds details on merger negotiations, financial analyses and projections; the agreed merger consideration remains $20.35 per share in cash.
During the go-shop period, the company contacted or was contacted by 122 parties and received no acquisition proposals.
The supplement does not change the merger terms or November 24 special meeting date, and the board continues to recommend a vote in favor.
